mechanism_narrative: A sharp increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPI) indicates inflationary pressure, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >60% of instances following a CPI increase of >0.5% within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) signals a tightening labor market, which is associated with increased consumer spending and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >50% of instances following a UNRATE decrease of >0.3pp within the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) indicates growing demand in the housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic growth and positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >60% of instances following an increase in HOUST over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) signals a weakening supply side of the economy, which can lead to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >50% of instances following a decrease in INDPRO of >0.5% within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is negative, it indicates a recessionary environment with potential for monetary easing, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >50% of instances following the trigger conditions within the next 60 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) coupled with a decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a strong labor market, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by >0.2% and UNRATE decreases by >0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >50% of instances following the trigger conditions within the next 20 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A significant increase in real final sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand, which is a positive signal for corporate earnings and S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows negative returns in >60% of instances following an increase in RSAFS of >1% within the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) combined with an increase in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) suggests a weakening economy, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO decreases by >0.5% and UNRATE increases by >0.3% in 1 month
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 shows positive returns in >50% of instances following the trigger conditions within the next 60 trading days.
